name: Orange Mandarin Cake
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Mix together, add beaten egg whites. Pour into 3 greased and floured layer pans. Bake 350 for 35-40 min.

ICING: 1 can crushed pineapple, 1 box instant vanilla pudding, 1 large container of Cool-Whip. Blend and spread between layers. Store in refrigerator.
